item.title: Baylor Gets Their 9th Straight Win Over Rival McCallie
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) After falling behind early, Baylor rallied to beat rival McCallie 53-46 on Friday night at the McCallie school. It was the Red Raiders 9th straight victory over the Blue Tornado. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Notre Dame Beats Silverdale 57-33
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) Mimi Lee scored 26 points, as Notre Dame got a big district win over Silverdale by a final of 57-33. Kinsley Owens paced the Seahawks with 17 points. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Ridgeland Takes Care of Rival LaFayette 42-29
item.description: Rossville, GA-(WDEF-TV) The Ridgeland girls basketball team rallied to beat rival LaFayette 42-29. The Panthers were down 9-4 after the first quarter, but then they held LaFayette to only one point in the second quarter thanks to their defensive pressure. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News

item.title: Heritage Downs NW Whitfield 60-45
item.description: Ringgold, GA-(WDEF-TV) After leading by only two at halftime, Heritage used a strong second half to beat NW Whitfield 60-45. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
